name: json-chat-export
extends: Hermes: stable JSON chat export with pagination (Phase 2)
description: Exports Hermes Agent chat sessions to stable, paginated JSON format. Reads from ~/.hermes/state.db session store. Supports single-session and bulk export with offset/limit pagination.
install: Copy module files to Jane install dir; add 'export' subcommand to CLI
uninstall: Remove module files; CLI reverts to base commands
